hypothesis: Test whether the mechanical elder-force-index interpretation improves month-level outcomes over the same-stock buy-and-hold control.

trader_attribution.name: Alexander Elder
trader_attribution.rule_interpretation: Smoothed Force Index crosses zero in direction of EMA50 trend; exit on opposite Force Index sign.

parameter_rationale: Two preregistered lookbacks bracket the published/default horizon; this is a bounded first grid, not a claim that all possible settings were searched.
baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and timeframe, filled next open
signal_rule: Smoothed Force Index crosses zero in direction of EMA50 trend; exit on opposite Force Index sign. All signals use completed bars and next-open fills; no current incomplete higher-timeframe bar.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Research ranking only; no automatic trading approval
limitations: Author's discretionary choices are not reproduced
